# PM-008: Gradient clipping too aggressive

## Metadata
- **PyTorch Issue**: N/A
- **PR**: N/A
- **Events Captured**: 9

## Root Cause
max_norm=1e-8 clips all gradients to near-zero

## Symptom
Model stops learning, loss plateaus immediately

## Causal Chain (NeuralDBG)
```
No chain
```

## Fix
Set max_norm=1.0 or higher. Typical values: 0.5-5.0
